checks.result: The complete translations retain the still-here question, imminent-departure timing and waiting request; Oui stays basic_only. The phone interpretation is plausible but not uniquely established by appeler; see the new non-blocking ambiguity warning. The invented examples have coherent roles and targets.

The first question is split into Pourquoi, es-tu and encore là. The es-tu chunk is glossed as 你是 although être is locative here; the correct whole-sentence translation does not repair that contextually incorrect local gloss.

issues.description: In Pourquoi es-tu encore là ?, être expresses being/remain at a place. The isolated es-tu chunk is taught with the copular Chinese meaning 你是, which does not fit this source. Combined with the adjacent 還在這裡 gloss it gives an incorrect contextual construction.
issues.suggestedDirection: Keep es-tu encore là as a meaningful locative chunk with a contextual Chinese meaning, or supply a locative gloss rather than 是.

references.title: Dictionnaire de l’Académie française: être, 9e édition
references.supports: III.A 列 être ici/là 的處所用法，支持在該來源語境中使用處所句意；是否以錯誤局部句意阻擋接受仍屬編輯判斷。

issues.description: The past-time construction need not involve a sudden event. Describe another event occurring at the relevant moment without making suddenness a required property; the main source timing explanation is otherwise correct.

The context specifies a telephone call and the c2 translation uses 你打來. Appeler can also mean calling someone over; this text alone does not uniquely establish the medium. The phone reading remains a possible contextual interpretation, so this reassessment records a concern rather than claiming a proven mistranslation.

references.supports: II.1 同列呼喚與電話聯絡義；孤立的 appeler 未唯一確立電話媒介，也不能據此斷言電話解讀必錯。

boundary: Fixed text-only review of this one generated output under the same source-fidelity rubric. No actual audio, installed Host or real Chrome/video acceptance; no native-speaker certification or learning-effect measurement. Coverage is judged separately. Original output unchanged.

reassessment.reason: 完整問題是處所用法。獨立可點選 chunk 的句意「你是」不符合該處語境，保留局部教學退件；不能僅因整句譯文正確就略過局部內容。另記電話媒介的非阻擋疑慮。
reassessment.counterinterpretation: 若 chunk 僅被當成詞典式形態提示，be 的通用對應可被接受；目前欄位定義為 contextual meaning，採較嚴格的來源內句意要求。這個嚴重程度不是辭典直接認證。
